name: Detect Objects
description: Detects objects in images using YOLOv8n (lightweight AI model). Outputs detected objects as text files with class names, confidence scores, and bounding boxes.

inputs.name: Input Directory
inputs.description: Directory containing images to analyze (PNG, JPG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, WEBP).

inputs.name: Confidence Threshold
inputs.description: Minimum confidence for detections (0.0-1.0). Lower values detect more objects but may include false positives.

outputs.name: Output Directory
outputs.description: Directory where detection results will be saved (one .txt and one .json file per image).
